This hides your network information from the person you\'re chatting with. When this is on, MindTheClub can deliver messages directly over Bluetooth to a nearby contact, with no internet, Wi-Fi or mobile data needed. It\'s handy when you\'re offline or out of signal. The other person must also have Bluetooth enabled and be paired with your device.
